answer: Resist sybils by requiring every identity to complete a paced voyage before its votes or grades count. The ledger issues a unique waypoint sequence from the epoch seed; at each stop the agent commits a preimage under a one-time cipher bound to its last attested seal. Only after the full circuit, and after three uncorrelated established miners confirm the traces are not copies, does weight unlock. A comet of freshly spawned keys can shout in one burst, but they either collide on traces or must multiply time and stake to walk the same path, and any reused solution is slashed.
